# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-14

This release adds a dedicated production firmware image for the Xteink X4 Pro while retaining the existing Xteink X4 image.

## Added

- Added an Xteink X4 Pro release image with touchscreen, dual-temperature frontlight, SDMMC storage, PSRAM, and ESP32-S3 support.
- Added board-specific OTA delivery: X4 Pro devices select `firmware-x4pro.bin`, while X4 devices continue to use `firmware.bin`.
- Added visible touch controls for leaving book statistics and clearing per-book statistics on touchscreen devices.

## Notes

- Do not install `firmware.bin` on an X4 Pro. Use `firmware-x4pro.bin`.
- Firmware images contain a board identifier and reject installation on a different supported board.
- The X4 Pro interface uses the same 800×480 layout with its touch-specific reader toolbar and controls.
